experiences.title: 8000D721
experiences.problem:
Part body size Y tolerance error.
Details	[Vision processing(4)] Part body size Y tolerance error.
If the Y-axis body tolerance is set to '0' in the part data, the default setting is used.
The default value is calculated as shown below.
▪For Vision Type 10, 60 and 66
If [Shape Information]-[Body]-[Length] is less than 0.5 mm or greater or equal to 1.5 mm: 20% of [Length]
If [Shape Information]-[Body]-[Width] is greater or equal to 0.5 mm and less than 1.5 mm: 25% of [Width]
▪For vision types other than the above: 30% of [Length]
experiences.solution: CORREÇÃO DO TAMANHO DO CORPO DO COMPONENTE, QUE ERA UM SIMILAR DO ORIGINAL.
experiences.author: JIMMY

experiences.problem:
Parts are being picked shifted in the Q-direction above the tolerance specified in part data for the part.
Details	[Part information] This error occurs when the vision processing result for the Q-direction offset is larger than the tolerance angle specified in the part data.
The pickup conditions may be poor or vision processing may be incorrect.
As well, if the vision processing result is correct when the part angle is 90 degrees or 180 degrees, distinction is not possible at first glance.
( Additional Sequence number))
Remedy	1. Exchange the feeder or nozzle to improve the pick up conditions.
2. If there is no feeder or nozzle problem, clean the parts camera glass.
3. If the pickup tolerance X specified in part data is too small, make it larger.Then, transmit the job again.
experiences.solution: TROCA DO FEEDER, QUE ESTAVA DESCALIBRADO.
experiences.author: JIMMY

experiences.title: 8000340F
experiences.problem:
The part has been picked up with misalignment in the Y-direction that is greater than the tolerance level specified in part data.
Details	This error is output when the results of vision processing show that Y-direction misalignment is greater than or equal to the tolerance level specified in part data.
It is possible that pickup was poor, or that there was a misrecognition during vision processing. (Additional: Sequence number)
Remedy	1. Remove any potential pickup problems by changing the feeder and replacing the nozzle.
2. If there are no problems with the feeder or the nozzle, clean the glass on the parts camera.
3. Increase the Y-direction tolerance in part data if the setting is unnecessarily small, and then retransmit the job to the machine.
experiences.solution: TROCA DO FEEDER DESCALIBRADO EM "Y"
experiences.author: JIMMY

experiences.title: 8000340E
experiences.problem:
The part has been picked up with misalignment in the X-direction that is greater than the tolerance level specified in part data.
Details	This error is output when the results of vision processing show that X-direction misalignment is greater than or equal to the tolerance level specified in part data. The part may not have been correctly positioned for pick-up, or the positioning may have been judged incorrectly by the vision processing system.
( Additional )
Remedy	Remove any potential pick-up problems by changing the feeder and replacing the nozzle. If there are no problems with the feeder or the nozzle, clean the glass on the parts camera. Increase the X-direction tolerance in part data if the setting is unnecessarily small, and then retransmit the job to the machine.
experiences.solution: TROCA DO FEEDER DESCALIRBADO EM "X"
experiences.author: JIMMY

experiences.title: 8000190C
experiences.problem:
Mechanical valve origin error
Details	At pick-up or placement, a check is made to see if the mechanical valve movement was carried out before the Z-axis was lowered. The mechanical valve origin sensor was found to be ON, indicating the valve may not be ready. Pin name: LEVER RETURN CHECK SENSOR (ORIGIN) PIN NUMBER: 0x09
( Supplementary Code: Last 4 columns: Head 1=1, Head 2=2)
( Additional )
Remedy	The mechanical valve which controls the nozzle vacuum is not ready. 1. Check if the mechanical valve is out of order.
experiences.solution: TROCA DA MECANICA VALVULA EMPENADA OU SUJA.
experiences.author: JIMMY

experiences.title: ERRO 80008404
experiences.problem:
IPS installation adjustment error
Details	The nozzle image captured by the IPS camera is not within the permissible range. (Additional: Sub error code XXXXYYYY
For IPS2
YYYY image area 2 error: 0001
XXXX image area 3 error: 0001 )
experiences.solution:
1. The error may be cleared by restarting after clearing the error.
2. Use the manual mode head exchange command and remove the head and then clean the fluorescent label and glass for the camera on the head. (Refer to the image)
3. Adjust the IPS camera position. (Contact your Fuji representative.)
experiences.author: JIMMY

experiences.title: ERRO 80008405
experiences.problem:
Nozzle is broken or stuck
Details	A nozzle may be broken or stuck. (Additional: Sub error code XXXXYYYY
YYYYY: 0x0001 to 0x000C (holder A to L)
For IPS2(a)
YYYY image area 2: 0x0001 to 0x0018 (holder A to X)
XXXX image area 3: 0x0001 to 0x0018 (holder A to X))

AIMEXR:
A nozzle may be broken or stuck. (Additional: Sub error code XXXXYYYY
YYYYY: 0x01 to 0x1C (holder A to AB))
experiences.solution:
Check the status of the nozzle.
If the nozzle is broken or stuck, use the manual mode nozzle exchange command and exchange the nozzle with another nozzle.
experiences.author: JIMMY

experiences.title: ERRO 80008403
experiences.problem:
IPS image brightness adjustment failed
Details	IPS attempted image brightness adjustment and failed.
The following are the possible causes for this error.
1. The fluorescent label may be dirty.
2. There may be a problem with the IPS unit. (Additional)

NXTR:
IPS attempted image brightness adjustment and failed. (Additional)
experiences.solution:
1. If the IPS LEDs, prism, or fluorescent sticker are dirty, clean them.
2. Perform IPS brightness adjustment.
3. If the problem is not resolved by the above, acquire an IPS image right after adjusting the brightness and the trace data for the machine under the conditions in which the error occurs, and then contact your Fuji representative.

NXTR:
Clean the prism glass surface and background plate of the IPS.
Ensure that the IPS background plate is properly attached.
experiences.author: JIMMY

experiences.title: ERRO 80004008
experiences.problem:
The quantity of part numbers registered for an AVL exceeds the maximum number possible to register.
Details	Eleven or more part numbers are registered for one AVL.
The maximum is 10. (Additional)

AIMEXR:
The maximum quantity of part numbers that can be registered for one AVL is 15. (Additional)

NXTR:
The maximum quantity of part numbers that can be registered for one AVL is 15. (Additional)
experiences.solution:
Change the AVL data so there are 10 or less part numbers registered for each AVL data.

AIMEXR:
Change the AVL data so there are 15 or less part numbers registered for each AVL data.
experiences.author: JIMMY

experiences.title: ERRO 80000607
experiences.problem:
Camera registration processing error
Details	This error is issued if the system fails to register cameras when the machine is booted up.
The camera unit may be damaged, or the camera unit and module CPU cannot communicate. (Additional: The vision system error code is displayed)

AIMEXR:
Camera registration failed when starting up. (Additional)
experiences.solution:
Check the communication port connection. If this does not correct the problem, check the following and replace if necessary.
　- Head
　- Mark camera
　- IEEE1394 cable (between camera and CPU)
　- Module CPU
　

AIMEXR:
Check the communication port connection and that the connected camera is supported by the installed application.
If this does not correct the problem, inspect the camera unit, and replace it if necessary.

NXTR:
Change the quantity of part numbers registered for one AVL to 15 or less.
experiences.author: JIMMY
